description: Frontier Intelligence Lab is a San Francisco-based team combining AI, cloud software, scientific research, and data engineering to solve challenges on Earth and in space. We aim to turn NASA open data into useful, testable applications with measurable impact. Seeking teammates skilled in astrophysics, Earth science, Python, satellite data, machine learning, UI/UX, visualization, and storytelling. All experience levels welcome; curiosity, collaboration, and scientific rigor matter.
